clips.title: The story
paras: After defeating the Bloodscalp witch doctor, his severed head speaks from the bubbling cauldron at Grom'gol Base Camp. He claims to know where the lost Darkspear child was taken, but he refuses to give up the secret without a grim tribute.

Though bound within the bubbling cauldron following the hunt for Bloodscalp Clan Heads, Nezzliok is far from cooperative. He admits knowing where Yenniku was taken, yet he demands appeasement before parting with the information. He commands that three trophy skulls be taken from the rival Skullsplitter tribe and brought to his resting place, ensuring his departed spirit will command thralls in the Nether.

Nezzliok demands one skull taken directly from the Skullsplitter trophy pile at Balia'mah, a second from Ziata'jai, and a third from Zul'Mamwe. Only when all three offerings rest alongside his own head will the dead witch doctor consider his spirit satisfied.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: It is true. I know where the child of the Darkspears was taken. You have bested me and bound my spirit, but I will say nothing without appeasement!

The Bloodscalps war with the Skullsplitters. To gain my favor, steal from the Skullsplitters 3 of their trophy skulls and place them here with us, so that my spirit will have slaves in the Nether. One skull must be from their trophy pile in Balia'mah, another from Ziata'jai, and the last from Zul'Mamwe.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Yes. These will serve me well. When my spirit is freed, I will enter the Nether with three fine servants!
You are a credit to your traveler clan, and you have appeased me.
